'''Inder Bir Singh Passi''' (20 August 1939 – 2 October 2021) was an Indian [[mathematician]] who specialised in [[algebra]].

IBS Passi was the former dean of university instructions (DUI) and professor emeritus of the department of mathematics at Panjab University.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-10-03|title=PU math professor IBS Passi passes away|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/chandigarh-news/pu-math-professor-ibs-passi-passes-away-101633212406177.html|access-date=2021-10-03|website=Hindustan Times|language=en}}</ref> He was awarded in 1983 the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], the highest science award in India, in the mathematical sciences category. Passi was a noted [[Group theory|group-theorist]] in India, had made significant contribution to certain aspects of [[Group theory|theory of groups]] specially to the study of [[group ring]]s. His results on the dimension subgroups, augmentation powers in group rings, and related problems have received wide recognition. His 1979 monograph<ref>{{cite book|last=Inder Bir Singh Passi|title=Group Rings and Their Augmentation Ideals|year=1979|publisher=Springer|pages=137}}</ref> summarizing the state of the subject is a basic reference source.<ref name=List>{{cite book|author1=Sukumar Mallick|author2=Saguna Dewan|author3=S C Dhawan|title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners(1958 - 1998)|year=1999|publisher=Human Rsource Development Group, [[Council of Scientific & Industrial Research]]|location=New Delhi|pages=118|url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf|access-date=23 June 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304043957/http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf|archive-date=4 March 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
